user.description: Connect to a Companion that is already running on the intercom, or install it on a rooted intercom over SSH.

menu_options.install: Install the Companion on the intercom

install.description: The intercom must be rooted and reachable over SSH. The SSH password is used only during this setup and is never stored.

data.host: Intercom IP address or host name

owner.description: Choose the username and password of the Companion web interface. `companion` is not allowed for either, and the password needs at least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes.

reboot.description: The Companion is installed and paired. The intercom must be rebooted before calls reach the Companion.

reboot_failed.description: The Companion did not accept the reboot request. Reboot the intercom by hand (switch its power off and on) before calls can reach the Companion, then submit to finish.

claim.description: Open the Companion Home Assistant page and enter its initial claim code.

recover.description: This Companion is already claimed. Open the Companion WebUI, issue a temporary recovery code, and enter it here.

progress.install: Installing the Companion on the intercom. This takes a few minutes.

error.ssh_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the intercom over SSH.
error.invalid_auth: The intercom refused the SSH username or password.
error.host_key_changed: The intercom's SSH key changed since the Companion was installed. If you reflashed the intercom, tick the box to accept its new key.
error.invalid_owner: Choose a username and a password other than `companion`; the password needs at least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes.

abort.setup_required: Finish the Companion WebUI setup before connecting Home Assistant.
abort.pairing_error: Companion pairing needs attention. Open its Home Assistant page for details.
abort.wrong_device: The Companion no longer matches this Home Assistant entry.
abort.reauth_started: Companion credentials need to be updated.
abort.ssh_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the intercom over SSH.
abort.already_in_progress: A setup for this Companion is already in progress.
